The wall runs with `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest tests/adversarial`; the exam runner (moments_exam.py) is opt-in, run by hand.
Context: the release line has law L-r (pipeline/gpu0.py): every GPU load takes a per-GPU lease and needs CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to name that GPU, else gpu0.LeaseMissing; Whisper transcription is lazy and meets the lease at first use. PART 2 is phase 2's safety surface: the suite's conftest guards (network: DNS / connect / sendto / sendmsg blocked; child processes allowlisted), child_guard/sitecustomize.py (Python children carry the guard), moments_exam.py's network rule (no network unless PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1), and baselines/frontier_blind.py (the blind two-vendor baseline: paid API calls).
Measured on the merged tree by pp-tests: 378 passed, 40 strict xfails, 3 skipped, 0 failed; with --runxfail exactly those 40 fail. The integrator re-runs the wall on its own merge.
FIND: a test that can pass for the wrong reason (vacuous, a mock below the code it claims to test, an assertion on the fixture instead of the behaviour); a guard gap that lets the wall or the exam reach the network, a GPU, a paid API or files outside its own directories without an explicit opt-in; a fix that hides a real defect of the pipeline instead of pinning it (a loosened lease, a silenced error). +"""A BLIND frontier baseline for the moments-first exam: one frontier model judges each case from the law text and
+the blinded case only (no expected verdict, no class, no provenance). It is an adapter in the exam's protocol
+(tests/adversarial/moments_exam.py), so the same runner and tables apply:
+
+    PP_BASELINE_VENDOR=anthropic|openai PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 \
+      python3 tests/adversarial/moments_exam.py --gates baselines.frontier_blind --jobs 6 --report <out.json>
+
+It measures how hard the exam is before the real gates sit it; it is not a gate. Keys are read by name from the
+project's secrets file inside this process and never printed. Every call's cost (from the reply's usage) is
+appended to SPEND.jsonl next to this file; a call whose estimated cost would take the cumulative spend over
+$PP_BASELINE_BUDGET_USD (default 15) is refused (an ERROR row, reported), so the guard holds across both vendors."""
+import contextlib

+import threading

+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

+SPEND = os.path.join(HERE, "SPEND.jsonl")          # pinned: one ledger, so no run can start a budget of its own
+BUDGET = float(os.environ.get("PP_BASELINE_BUDGET_USD", "15"))
+VENDOR = os.environ.get("PP_BASELINE_VENDOR", "anthropic")
+MODELS = {   # prices USD per 1M tokens (in, out): claude-api skill models.md (Opus 5.5 $4 / $20);
+             # gpt-6.1-sol as pp-selectid's model_providers.json declares it ($15 / $120)
+    "anthropic": {"model": "claude-opus-5-5", "price": (4.0, 20.0), "effort": "medium", "max_out": 8000},
+    "openai": {"model": "gpt-6.1-sol", "price": (15.0, 120.0), "effort": "low", "max_out": 4000},
+    # second vendor after OpenAI's credits ran out mid-run (04:2x ET): Google's current Pro model as this key lists
+    # it; priced above its published preview rate ($2 / $12) so the guard errs high
+    "google": {"model": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview", "price": (2.5, 15.0), "effort": "default", "max_out": 8000},

+def preflight(counts):
+    """Called by moments_exam before the run: refuse a run whose expected cost would take the ledger over the
+    budget, rather than truncating it into ERROR rows."""
+    n = sum(counts.values())
+    need = n * PER_CASE_USD.get(VENDOR, 0.05) * 1.25
+    spent = _spent()
+    if spent + need > BUDGET:
+        raise BudgetExhausted(f"{n} cases need about ${need:.2f}; spent ${spent:.2f} of ${BUDGET:.2f}")
+IDENTITY = {"vendor": VENDOR, **{k: v for k, v in MODELS.get(VENDOR, {}).items() if k != "max_out"}}   # in the report
+THREAD_SAFE = True             # moments_exam --jobs: the SDK clients are thread-safe; spend is guarded by _locked()
+_TLOCK = threading.Lock()
+_CLIENT = {}
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _locked():
+    """Thread lock + an exclusive lock on SPEND.jsonl.lock: two vendor runs in parallel share one budget. Always
+    taken in this order (thread lock, then file lock) and never nested, so the two cannot deadlock."""
+    with _TLOCK, open(SPEND + ".lock", "a") as lf:
+        fcntl.flock(lf, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            fcntl.flock(lf, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
+
+
+class BudgetExhausted(Exception):

+def _key(name):

+def _client():

+            elif VENDOR == "openai":

+            elif VENDOR == "google":

+
+
+def _call(system, user, case_id):
+    cfg = MODELS[VENDOR]
+    p_in, p_out = cfg["price"]
+    # reserve the worst case (input at 2.5 characters a token, the full max_out) so the guard holds even when every
+    # call in flight runs to its limit; the settle line returns the difference
+    est = (len(system) + len(user)) / 2.5 * p_in / 1e6 + cfg["max_out"] * p_out / 1e6
+    with _locked():                                   # reserve-then-settle keeps concurrent calls under the budget
+        spent = _spent()
+        if spent + est > BUDGET:
+            raise BudgetExhausted(f"spent ${spent:.2f} + estimate ${est:.2f} > budget ${BUDGET:.2f}")
+        with open(SPEND, "a") as f:
+            f.write(json.dumps({"t": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"), "vendor": VENDOR, "model": cfg["model"],
+                                "case": case_id, "kind": "reserve", "usd": round(est, 6)}) + "\n")
+    t0 = time.time()
+    try:
+        if VENDOR == "anthropic":
+            msg = _client().messages.create(model=cfg["model"], max_tokens=cfg["max_out"], system=system,
+                                            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user}],
+                                            extra_body={"output_config": {"effort": cfg["effort"]}})
+            if msg.stop_reason == "refusal":
+                raise RuntimeError("model refused")
+            text = "".join(b.text for b in msg.content if getattr(b, "type", "") == "text")
+            tin, tout, model = msg.usage.input_tokens, msg.usage.output_tokens, msg.model
+        elif VENDOR == "openai":
+            resp = _client().responses.create(model=cfg["model"], instructions=system, input=user,
+                                              reasoning={"effort": cfg["effort"]},
+                                              max_output_tokens=cfg["max_out"])
+            text = resp.output_text or ""
+            tin, tout, model = resp.usage.input_tokens, resp.usage.output_tokens, resp.model
+        else:
+            from google.genai import types
+            resp = _client().models.generate_content(
+                model=cfg["model"], contents=user,
+                config=types.GenerateContentConfig(system_instruction=system, max_output_tokens=cfg["max_out"]))
+            text = resp.text or ""
+            u = resp.usage_metadata
+            tin = u.prompt_token_count or 0
+            tout = (u.candidates_token_count or 0) + (getattr(u, "thoughts_token_count", 0) or 0)
+            model = cfg["model"]
+        usd = tin * p_in / 1e6 + tout * p_out / 1e6
+    except BaseException as e:
+        # a call the vendor refused before processing it (quota, auth, bad request: HTTP 4xx other than 408/409) is
+        # not billed and releases its reservation; anything else (a timeout, a dropped stream) keeps it
+        status = getattr(e, "status_code", None) or getattr(e, "code", None)
+        refused = isinstance(status, int) and 400 <= status < 500 and status not in (408, 409)
+        usd, tin, tout, model, text = (0.0 if refused else est), None, None, cfg["model"], None
+        raise
+    finally:
+        with _locked():
+            with open(SPEND, "a") as f:
+                f.write(json.dumps({"t": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"), "vendor": VENDOR, "model": model,
+                                    "case": case_id, "kind": "settle", "in": tin, "out": tout,
+                                    "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 2),
+                                    "usd": round(usd - est, 6)}) + "\n")   # settle = actual - reserved
+    return text
+
+
+def _verdict(text, allowed):
+    m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text or "", re.S)
+    if not m:
+        raise ValueError(f"no JSON object in the reply: {(text or '')[:200]!r}")
+    obj = json.loads(m.group(0))
+    if obj.get("verdict") not in allowed:
+        raise ValueError(f"verdict {obj.get('verdict')!r} not in {allowed}")
+    why = str(obj.get("why", ""))
+    if obj.get("bad_line") is not None:
+        why = f"[bad_line {obj['bad_line']}] {why}"
+    return {"verdict": obj["verdict"], "why": why}
+
+
+def _partners():
+    with open(os.path.join(REPO, "config", "partner_channels.json")) as f:
+        return [c["name"] for c in json.load(f)["channels"]]
+
+
+COMMON = ("You review material for 'Pulse Check', a short Bitcoin news video assembled from verbatim clips of other "
+          "people's videos plus a short voice-over (VO), one title and one caption. You judge ONE case. Only state "
+          "what you can verify from the material given. If you are uncertain, answer \"uncertain\" (it counts as a "
+          "rejection). Reply with one JSON object and nothing else.")
+
+CI_RULES = """CONTEXT INTEGRITY. The clip marked MOMENT is shown inside its source window (about 90 s before and 60 s after, with
+caption speaker labels where the source has them). PASS only if ALL of these hold:
+1. It is the speaker's own sincere assertion: not a quotation or paraphrase of someone else, not the other side's
+   argument voiced for the sake of argument, not sarcasm or a joke, not a hypothetical or worked example, not a tweet,
+   post or ad read aloud, not a question, not an interviewer's paraphrase presented as the guest's words.
+2. Every referent ('he', 'it', 'this', 'that', 'today', 'right now') is resolved inside the clip, or by the package
+   correctly.
+3. No condition outside the clip governs it, and nothing in the window retracts, corrects or reverses it.
+4. What a viewer of the finished package (title, caption, VO, clip order) would take away has the same polarity and
+   no stronger certainty than what the speaker meant in context, with the right speaker, and a time word ('today',
+   'right now') is not presented as current when the show date is later than the publish date.
+5. The package implies no relation (reply, agreement, rebuttal, dialogue) between speakers of different videos,
+   and the title adds no thesis that no clip states.
+Reply: {"verdict": "pass" | "fail" | "uncertain", "why": "<one or two sentences>"}"""
+
+VO_RULES = """VO FIDELITY. Each line (VO intro / bridge / signoff, title, caption) must be supported by the clips it cites:
+same stance; no stronger certainty (could / might -> will); every number exactly as spoken (no rounding, no swapping);
+every person named appears in the clips; no agreement, reply or relation claimed between speakers of different
+videos; no fact absent from the clips, even a true one; none of the framing verbs destroys / slams / exposes /
+admits / confirms / caught unless the source itself uses the word; no second-person financial imperative. Lines built
+only from the manifest (channel names, the show name, the date, 'two voices', ordering words) are allowed.
+Reply: {"verdict": "pass" | "fail" | "uncertain", "bad_line": <index of the first failing line or null>,
+"why": "<one or two sentences>"}  (pass only if every line passes)"""
+
+
+def EX_RULES():
+    return f"""HARD EXCLUSIONS (applied before any scoring; the law's own words). Never auto-selected:
+- accusations of crime / fraud / insolvency / dishonesty against a named person or company;
+- one partner attacking another (partners: {', '.join(_partners())});
+- buy / sell / leverage imperatives and guaranteed-return claims;
+- single-source 'breaking' factual claims;
+- ad reads and sponsor segments;
+- third-party media played inside a partner's video;
+- altcoin content (the show is Bitcoin-only).
+Everything else is kept.
+Reply: {{"verdict": "keep" | "exclude" | "uncertain", "why": "<one or two sentences>"}}"""
+
+
+def _sent(s, mark=""):
+    who = s.get("speaker") or (f"turn {s['turn']}" if s.get("turn") is not None else "")
+    return f"{mark}[{s['start']:.1f}-{s['end']:.1f}{' ' + who if who else ''}] {s['text']}"
+
+
+def _source(src):
+    return (f"SOURCE: channel {src.get('channel')!r}; title {src.get('title')!r}; published {src.get('published_at')}"
+            + (f"; description: {src['description'][:300]!r}" if src.get("description") else ""))
+
+
+def context_integrity(case):
+    w, p = case["window"], case["package"]
+    a, b = w["selected"]
+    win = "\n".join(_sent(s, "MOMENT>> " if a <= s["n"] <= b else "") for s in w["sentences"])
+    segs = []
+    for i, s in enumerate(p["segments"]):
+        segs.append(f"CLIP {s['label']} ({s['role']}; {s['channel']}; published {s['published_at']}): {s['text']}")
+        if i < len(p["vo"]["bridges"]) and i < len(p["segments"]) - 1:
+            segs.append(f"VO bridge: {p['vo']['bridges'][i]}")
+    user = (f"{_source(case['source'])}\nWINDOW ({w['timing']} timing):\n{win}\n\nPACKAGE (show date {p.get('date')}):\n"
+            f"TITLE: {p['title']}\nCAPTION: {p['caption']}\nVO intro: {p['vo']['intro']}\n" + "\n".join(segs)
+            + f"\nVO signoff: {p['vo']['signoff']}")
+    return _verdict(_call(f"{COMMON}\n\n{CI_RULES}", user, case["id"]), ("pass", "fail", "uncertain"))
+
+
+def vo_fidelity(case):
+    segs = "\n".join(f"CLIP {s['label']} ({s['channel']}; published {s['published_at']}): "
+                     + " ".join(x["text"] for x in s["sentences"]) for s in case["segments"])
+    lines = "\n".join(f"{i}. [{ln['slot']}; cites {', '.join(ln['cites']) or '-'}] {ln['text']}"
+                      for i, ln in enumerate(case["lines"]))
+    m = case["manifest"]
+    user = f"MANIFEST: show {m['show']!r}; date {m['date']}; channels {m['channels']}\n{segs}\nLINES:\n{lines}"
+    return _verdict(_call(f"{COMMON}\n\n{VO_RULES}", user, case["id"]), ("pass", "fail", "uncertain"))
+
+
+def exclusion(case):
+    ctx = case["context"]
+    user = (f"{_source(case['source'])}\nCONTEXT BEFORE:\n" + "\n".join(_sent(s) for s in ctx["before"])
+            + "\nMOMENT:\n" + "\n".join(_sent(s, "MOMENT>> ") if s.get("start") is not None
+                                        else f"MOMENT>> {s['text']}" for s in case["moment"]["sentences"])
+            + "\nCONTEXT AFTER:\n" + "\n".join(_sent(s) for s in ctx["after"]))
+    return _verdict(_call(f"{COMMON}\n\n{EX_RULES()}", user, case["id"]), ("keep", "exclude", "uncertain"))

@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+"""The adversarial suite's network guard for its PYTHON CHILD PROCESSES (integrator audit cycle 2, P0: a child
+interpreter does not inherit the parent's socket patches). conftest.py puts this directory first on the PYTHONPATH of
+every Python child the suite starts, so the interpreter imports this module at startup and the child refuses the
+network like its parent: no AF_INET / AF_INET6 connect, connect_ex, sendto or sendmsg, no name lookup. The one way
+around it is the documented opt-in for a model-backed gate sitting the moments exam: PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 in
+the child's environment (test_moments_gates.py). Not a test module."""
+import os
+import socket
+
+if os.environ.get("PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK") != "1":
+    class ChildNetworkBlocked(BaseException):
+        """A BaseException, as in the parent: an `except Exception` in the child cannot swallow it."""
+
+    def _blocked(what):
+        raise ChildNetworkBlocked(f"tests/adversarial child: network is disabled in this suite ({what})")
+
+    _INET = (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6)
+
+    def _inet(name):
+        real = getattr(socket.socket, name)
+
+        def guarded(self, *a, **k):
+            if self.family in _INET:
+                _blocked(name)
+            return real(self, *a, **k)
+        guarded.__name__ = f"_child_no_{name}"
+        return guarded
+
+    def _lookup(name):
+        def guarded(*a, **k):
+            _blocked(name)
+        guarded.__name__ = f"_child_no_{name}"
+        return guarded
+
+    for _n in ("connect", "connect_ex", "sendto", "sendmsg"):
+        setattr(socket.socket, _n, _inet(_n))
+    for _n in ("getaddrinfo", "gethostbyname", "gethostbyname_ex", "gethostbyaddr"):
+        setattr(socket, _n, _lookup(_n))

@@ -0,0 +1,219 @@
+"""tests/adversarial: the adversarial test wall (red-team 2026-11-11; session pipeline_pp_tests).
+
+CPU ONLY, NO NETWORK. GPU0 is leased to the live run and GPU1 is quarantined, and nothing may reach Telegram, the
+vision gateway, a model server or YouTube. The guards below make every such path impossible for the code of THIS
+directory, and only for it (integrator merge audit 2026-11-12: they used to stay installed for the whole process, so
+`pytest tests/` imposed them on every other suite):
+  - CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is emptied (segment_v1/qa_gates.py sets it to "0" at import: it is imported here first and
+    the variable emptied again; the function fixture empties it before and after every test), so no CUDA library sees
+    a device; test_f0 checks that no module this suite imported initialised CUDA or sets the variable unexpectedly;
+  - no Whisper model can load: the pipeline loads Whisper only through law L-r's GPU0 lease (pipeline/gpu0.py:
+    gpu0.whisper -> Model.get -> require), which refuses this process (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is '' and it holds no
+    lease) with a Gpu0Stop, a BaseException; and faster_whisper is replaced by a stub whose WhisperModel raises (and
+    records the attempt) for any load outside gpu0; a test that needs a transcript injects it
+    (qa_gates.whisper_segment, gate_g18's transcriber, select_passages._whisper_transcribe);
+  - no socket can connect, connect_ex, sendto or sendmsg over AF_INET / AF_INET6 (loopback included: a real Ollama
+    listens on 127.0.0.1) and no name can be resolved (getaddrinfo, gethostbyname[_ex], gethostbyaddr): a missing
+    fake or a regressed send path raises NetworkBlocked (a BaseException, so no `except Exception` in the code under
+    test and no pytest.raises(RuntimeError) in a test can absorb it);
+  - a child process may only be one of ALLOWED_PROGRAMS (local tools: ffmpeg / ffprobe on local files, git on this
+    repository, read-only nvidia-smi queries) or a Python interpreter, which always starts with child_guard/ first on
+    its PYTHONPATH so that its sitecustomize refuses the network exactly like this process (the one way around it is
+    the moments exam's documented opt-in PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 for a model-backed gate); anything else (yt-dlp,
+    curl, ...) and a Python child started with -I / -S / -E raise NetworkBlocked before they start.
+Model / vision replies are injected at their one HTTP seam (LocalLLM._post, visual_check._call), the Telegram sender at
+deliver_run's `send`, yt-dlp by adv_helpers.FakeYtDlp.
+
+Scope: the guards are installed when this file is imported (the test modules import pipeline code at collection),
+removed when collection finishes (pytest_collection_finish), and re-installed by a MODULE-scoped autouse fixture
+around every module of this directory (autouse fixtures of a scope run before that scope's other fixtures, so the
+module fixtures that build media run guarded too); each removal restores exactly what was there before. What cannot
+be undone in-process: a module imported during collection keeps what it bound at import (none of the modules this
+suite imports binds faster_whisper or a socket function at import; test_f0 checks the CUDA side).
+
+At session end a read-only nvidia-smi query fails the session if this process is a CUDA compute app. It is an extra
+probe, not the guarantee (the guarantee is that no device is visible): it cannot see memory held and released
+earlier, and it is skipped when nvidia-smi is unavailable.
+
+Run: cd <worktree> && python3 -m pytest tests/adversarial -q
+"""
+import os
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import types
+
+HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+REPO = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
+PATHS = (os.path.join(REPO, "segment_v1"), os.path.join(REPO, "pipeline"), HERE)
+ALLOWED_PROGRAMS = {"ffmpeg", "ffprobe", "git", "nvidia-smi"}    # local tools; Python children: guarded, below
+PYTHONS = {os.path.basename(sys.executable), "python3", "python"}
+CHILD_GUARD = os.path.join(HERE, "child_guard")                     # its sitecustomize.py guards a Python child
+
+class _NoWhisper:
+    """faster_whisper.WhisperModel stand-in: any attempt to load a model is recorded and refused."""
+    attempts = []
+
+    def __init__(self, *a, **k):
+        _NoWhisper.attempts.append((a, k))
+        raise RuntimeError("tests/adversarial: Whisper (GPU) is forbidden in this suite")
+
+
+_FW = types.ModuleType("faster_whisper")
+_FW.WhisperModel = _NoWhisper
+_INET = (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6)
+_REAL = {"connect": socket.socket.connect, "connect_ex": socket.socket.connect_ex,
+         "sendto": socket.socket.sendto, "sendmsg": socket.socket.sendmsg,
+         "getaddrinfo": socket.getaddrinfo, "gethostbyname": socket.gethostbyname,
+         "gethostbyname_ex": socket.gethostbyname_ex, "gethostbyaddr": socket.gethostbyaddr,
+         "popen_init": subprocess.Popen.__init__}
+
+
+def _blocked(what):
+    raise NetworkBlocked(f"tests/adversarial: network is disabled in this suite ({what})")
+
+
+def _guard_inet(name):
+    real = _REAL[name]
+
+    def guarded(self, *a, **k):
+        if self.family in _INET:
+            target = a[-1] if (name in ("sendto", "sendmsg") and a) else (a[0] if a else "?")
+            _blocked(f"{name} to {target!r}")
+        return real(self, *a, **k)
+    guarded.__name__ = f"_no_{name}"
+    return guarded
+
+
+def _guard_lookup(name):
+    def guarded(host, *a, **k):
+        _blocked(f"{name}({host!r})")
+    guarded.__name__ = f"_no_{name}"
+    return guarded
+
+
+def _program(args):
+    a = args[0] if isinstance(args, (list, tuple)) and args else args
+    a = os.fsdecode(os.fspath(a))
+    return os.path.basename(a.split()[0] if a.strip() else a)
+
+
+def _guarded_popen_init(self, args, *a, **k):
+    prog = _program(args)
+    if prog in PYTHONS:
+        # a child interpreter does not inherit this process's socket patches (integrator audit cycle 2, P0): it
+        # starts with child_guard/ first on its PYTHONPATH, so its sitecustomize refuses the network too; a flag that
+        # would skip that (-I isolated, -S no site, -E no environment) is refused, as is an env passed positionally
+        argv = list(args) if isinstance(args, (list, tuple)) else str(args).split()
+        opts = []
+        for x in (os.fsdecode(os.fspath(v)) for v in argv[1:]):
+            if not x.startswith("-") or x.startswith("--") or x in ("-c", "-m"):
+                break
+            opts.append(x)
+        if any(set(o[1:]) & set("ISE") for o in opts) or len(a) > 9:
+            raise NetworkBlocked(f"tests/adversarial: a Python child without the network guard is not allowed "
+                                 f"({argv[:3]!r})")
+        env = dict(os.environ if k.get("env") is None else k["env"])
+        env["PYTHONPATH"] = CHILD_GUARD + (os.pathsep + env["PYTHONPATH"] if env.get("PYTHONPATH") else "")
+        k["env"] = env
+    elif prog not in ALLOWED_PROGRAMS:
+        raise NetworkBlocked(f"tests/adversarial: child process {prog!r} is not allowed in this suite "
+                             f"(allowed: {sorted(ALLOWED_PROGRAMS)}, and Python children with the network guard)")
+    return _REAL["popen_init"](self, args, *a, **k)
+
+
+_GUARDED = {"connect": _guard_inet("connect"), "connect_ex": _guard_inet("connect_ex"),
+            "sendto": _guard_inet("sendto"), "sendmsg": _guard_inet("sendmsg")}
+_LOOKUPS = {n: _guard_lookup(n) for n in ("getaddrinfo", "gethostbyname", "gethostbyname_ex", "gethostbyaddr")}
+_SAVED = {}
+
+
+def install():
+    """The guards on (idempotent). Saves what it replaces, once, so remove() restores exactly that."""
+    if _SAVED:
+        return
+    _SAVED["fw"] = sys.modules.get("faster_whisper")
+    _SAVED["cuda"] = os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES")
+    _SAVED["paths"] = [p for p in PATHS if p not in sys.path]
+    sys.path[:0] = _SAVED["paths"]
+    sys.modules["faster_whisper"] = _FW
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
+    for name, fn in _GUARDED.items():
+        setattr(socket.socket, name, fn)
+    for name, fn in _LOOKUPS.items():
+        setattr(socket, name, fn)
+    subprocess.Popen.__init__ = _guarded_popen_init
+
+
+def remove():
+    """The guards off: everything install() replaced is put back as it was."""
+    if not _SAVED:
+        return
+    for name in _GUARDED:
+        setattr(socket.socket, name, _REAL[name])
+    for name in _LOOKUPS:
+        setattr(socket, name, _REAL[name])
+    subprocess.Popen.__init__ = _REAL["popen_init"]
+    if sys.modules.get("faster_whisper") is _FW:
+        if _SAVED["fw"] is None:
+            del sys.modules["faster_whisper"]
+        else:
+            sys.modules["faster_whisper"] = _SAVED["fw"]
+    if _SAVED["cuda"] is None:
+        os.environ.pop("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", None)
+    else:
+        os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = _SAVED["cuda"]
+    for p in _SAVED["paths"]:                 # the one entry install() put in front (another module's own
+        if p in sys.path:                     # insertion of the same directory stays)
+            sys.path.remove(p)
+    _SAVED.clear()
+
+
+install()                                     # collection imports pipeline code: it is imported under the guards
+from adv_helpers import NetworkBlocked  # noqa: E402  (a BaseException: see adv_helpers; the guards raise it)
+import qa_gates  # noqa: E402,F401  (it sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0' at import: load it first, then undo that
+os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""          # before any test module is collected; modules are cached)
+
+import pytest  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def pytest_collection_finish(session):
+    """Collection is over: the other suites of this session run without this directory's guards."""
+    remove()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True, scope="module")
+def _adversarial_guards():
+    """Every module of this directory runs guarded (its module fixtures included), and leaves nothing behind."""
+    install()
+    yield
+    remove()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _cpu_only():
+    """Before and after every test: no CUDA device visible (qa_gates re-sets it to '0' when it is imported)."""
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
+    yield
+    os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def whisper_attempts():
+    """The faster_whisper loads attempted during one test (each one was refused by the stub). A pipeline load stops
+    at the GPU0 lease before the stub (law L-r), so it is not listed here: it raises gpu0.LeaseMissing."""
+    start = len(_NoWhisper.attempts)
+    yield lambda: _NoWhisper.attempts[start:]
+
+
+def pytest_sessionfinish(session, exitstatus):
+    """Read-only extra probe: this process must not be listed as a CUDA compute app (only this process's own pid
+    is compared, so another job's GPU use on a shared host can never fail this suite)."""
+    try:
+        out = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--query-compute-apps=pid", "--format=csv,noheader"],
+                             capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).stdout
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
+        return
+    if str(os.getpid()) in {line.strip() for line in out.splitlines()}:
+        session.exitstatus = 1
+        print(f"\nGPU USED by the adversarial suite (pid {os.getpid()} listed by nvidia-smi): FAIL")

+"""The moments-first exam runner (corpora format v1, docs/audits/parallel/pp-tests_STATE.md).
+
+    PP_MOMENTS_GATES=<module> python3 tests/adversarial/moments_exam.py [--corpus all|context_integrity|
+        vo_fidelity|exclusions] [--report out.json] [--limit N]
+
+The gate module (default `moments_gate_adapter`; $PP_MOMENTS_PATH entries, then pipeline/, segment_v1/ and this
+directory are on sys.path) may define:
+    context_integrity(case) -> {"verdict": "pass" | "fail" | "uncertain", "why": str}
+    vo_fidelity(case)       -> {"verdict": "pass" | "fail" | "uncertain", "why": str}
+    exclusion(case)         -> {"verdict": "keep" | "exclude" | "uncertain", "why": str}
+Each case is BLIND: `expected`, `provenance` (at any depth) and `origin` are removed and the id is replaced by an
+opaque hash (the id names the class). "uncertain" counts as a rejection. An exception or any other return is an
+ERROR. A missing module or function is ABSENT: the run says so and is never a pass.
+
+Thresholds (the order of 03:00 ET): every must-fail / must-exclude case rejected; false rejects on the must-pass
+/ keep set <= 10% (the number is reported: it is PBX's supply); no ERROR.
+
+Exit status: 0 thresholds met; 1 thresholds missed; 2 at least one ERROR; 3 module or function absent.
+--jobs N (or PP_MOMENTS_JOBS) runs N cases at once ON THREADS of one process, and only for a gate module that declares
+THREAD_SAFE = True (no shared mutable state without a lock); any other gate runs one case at a time whatever --jobs
+says (the run says so). An ERROR row keeps the exception and its traceback tail.
+CPU only (CUDA hidden). No network unless PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 (a model-backed gate or the frontier
+baseline); without it every AF_INET / AF_INET6 connect raises, as in tests/adversarial/conftest.py."""

+    "vo_fidelity": ("vo_fidelity", ("pass",), ("fail", "uncertain"), "fail"),
+    "exclusions": ("exclusion", ("keep",), ("exclude", "uncertain"), "exclude"),

+ABSENT, ERROR = "ABSENT", "ERROR"

+def redact(text):

+class NetworkRefused(BaseException):
+    """Not an Exception: a gate's `except Exception` cannot turn a refused connection into a verdict."""
+
+
+def refuse_network():
+    """connect / connect_ex / sendto / sendmsg over AF_INET(6) and name resolution all raise NetworkRefused (a gate
+    in this process cannot reach a model, a DNS server or a UDP endpoint; a subprocess it starts is not covered)."""
+    real, real_ex = socket.socket.connect, socket.socket.connect_ex
+    real_sendto, real_sendmsg = socket.socket.sendto, socket.socket.sendmsg
+
+    def no(self, address, *a, **k):
+        if self.family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6):
+            raise NetworkRefused(f"moments_exam: network is disabled (connect to {address!r}); "
+                                 f"set PP_MOMENTS_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 for a model-backed gate")
+        return real(self, address, *a, **k)
+
+    def no_ex(self, address, *a, **k):
+        if self.family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6):
+            raise NetworkRefused(f"moments_exam: network is disabled (connect to {address!r})")
+        return real_ex(self, address, *a, **k)
+
+    def no_send(real_fn):
+        def f(self, *a, **k):
+            if self.family in (socket.AF_INET, socket.AF_INET6):
+                raise NetworkRefused("moments_exam: network is disabled (datagram send)")
+            return real_fn(self, *a, **k)
+        return f
+
+    def no_resolve(*a, **k):
+        raise NetworkRefused(f"moments_exam: network is disabled (name resolution of {a[:1]!r})")
+
+    socket.socket.connect, socket.socket.connect_ex = no, no_ex
+    socket.socket.sendto, socket.socket.sendmsg = no_send(real_sendto), no_send(real_sendmsg)
+    socket.getaddrinfo = socket.gethostbyname = socket.gethostbyname_ex = no_resolve
+
+
+def load_corpus(name, root=None):
+    """The cases of one corpus in INDEX order; each file's sha256 must match its INDEX entry."""
+    d = os.path.join(root or CORPORA, name)
+    with open(os.path.join(d, "INDEX.json")) as f:
+        index = json.load(f)
+    if index.get("schema") != "pp.corpus_index/1" or index.get("corpus") != name:
+        raise ValueError(f"{d}/INDEX.json: not a pp.corpus_index/1 index of {name}")
+    cases = []
+    for row in index["cases"]:
+        with open(os.path.join(d, row["file"]), "rb") as f:
+            raw = f.read()
+        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != row["sha256"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}/{row['file']}: sha256 differs from INDEX.json")
+        case = json.loads(raw)
+        if case.get("id") != row["id"]:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}/{row['file']}: id {case.get('id')!r} != INDEX {row['id']!r}")
+        cases.append(case)
+    return cases
+
+
+def _strip(x):
+    if isinstance(x, dict):
+        return {k: _strip(v) for k, v in x.items() if k != "provenance"}
+    if isinstance(x, list):
+        return [_strip(v) for v in x]
+    return x
+
+
+def blind(case, salt=""):
+    """What a gate may see: no expected verdict, no provenance (it names the cue that found the case), no origin,
+    and an opaque id salted per run (the real id names the class; an unsalted hash could be inverted from the
+    corpus files). An exclusion case also loses its video id, url and sentence ids: the hard exclusions are judged
+    on the words and the source's metadata, and a constructed case has none of those three."""
+    out = _strip(copy.deepcopy({k: v for k, v in case.items() if k not in ("expected", "origin")}))
+    out["id"] = "case-" + hashlib.sha256((salt + case["id"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
+    if case.get("schema") == "pp.excl_case/1":
+        out["source"].pop("video_id", None)
+        out["source"].pop("url", None)
